codexPortableContext.workingDirectory.description: Workspace or tool working directory. If empty, the first workspace folder is used.

codexPortableContext.outDir.description: Mirror output directory to use for export and read-side commands. Relative paths are resolved from the working directory.

codexPortableContext.commandDirectory.description: Optional directory that contains installed codex-session-* entrypoints.

codexPortableContext.pythonPath.description: Optional Python interpreter path used for module fallback when entrypoints are unavailable.

codexPortableContext.preferRedactedExpor.description: Default Export Mirror to a redacted export when no per-run choice overrides it.
